module: Ray picking utility against axis-aligned boxes (AABB), without allocation. Used by editor tools that need to pick a world object by its bounding box (e.g. placed building instances). Linear scan of the candidates.
notes: The ray direction does not need to be normalized; the distance t is then expressed in multiples of this direction.
A ray starting inside the box returns 0.

rayAabb.desc: Ray/AABB test using the slab method. Returns the entry distance t along the ray (>= 0) if hit, otherwise nil.

minx.desc: Min corner of the box, x

miny.desc: Min corner of the box, y

minz.desc: Min corner of the box, z

maxx.desc: Max corner of the box, x

maxy.desc: Max corner of the box, y

maxz.desc: Max corner of the box, z

returns.desc: Entry distance, or nil if the ray misses the box or if it is behind it.

pickNearest.desc: Returns the id of the closest box (by entry distance) that the ray crosses. The provider provider(visit) must call visit(id, minx, miny, minz, maxx, maxy, maxz) once per candidate box.

provider.desc: function(visit) that enumerates the boxes via visit(id, minx, miny, minz, maxx, maxy, maxz).

returns.desc: Winning id, or nil if no box is hit.
Entry distance of the winner (absent if nil).
